import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from sklearn.feature_selection import f_classif
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

def load(p):
    t = np.loadtxt(p, delimiter=",", skiprows=1)
    return t[:, :-1], t[:, -1]

Xp, yp = load("data/pilot.csv")
Xh, yh = load("data/heldout.csv")
print("pilot", Xp.shape, "pos", int((yp==1).sum()), "neg", int((yp==-1).sum()))
print("heldout", Xh.shape, "pos", int((yh==1).sum()), "neg", int((yh==-1).sum()))

# F-stats fitted on pilot only, then check those features on heldout (diagnostic)
F, p = f_classif(Xp, yp)
order = np.argsort(-F)
top30 = order[:30]; top50 = order[:50]; top100 = order[:100]
print("pilot F top10 idx:", top10 := order[:10], "\n  F:", np.round(F[top10],1))
print("pilot F stats: top30 range F", round(F[top30].min(),1), "-", round(F[top30].max(),1),
      "| rank50 min", round(F[order[49]],1))

# single-feature sign-adjusted AUC on each dataset for the pilot-selected features
def signed_auc(x, y):
    a = roc_auc_score(y, x)
    return max(a, 1-a)

def expr_auc(feats, X, y, name):
    aucs = np.array([signed_auc(X[:, j], y) for j in feats])
    print(f"{name}: mean {aucs.mean():.3f} median {np.median(aucs):.3f} "
          f">=0.55: {(aucs>=0.55).sum()}/{len(feats)} max {aucs.max():.3f} min {aucs.min():.3f}")

for k, feats in [("top30", top30), ("top50", top50), ("top100", top100)]:
    expr_auc(feats, Xp, yp, f"{k} on pilot")
    expr_auc(feats, Xh, yh, f"{k} on heldout")

# How many of the top-pilot features are strong on heldout individually?
# And conversely: are the strongly-heldout features also rated high on pilot? (rank agreement)
Fh, _ = f_classif(Xh, yh)
orderh = np.argsort(-Fh)
for k in (30, 50, 100):

    print(f"pilot-F top{k} ∩ heldout-F top{k}: {overlap}")
